mapper.select: SELECT A.AUTHRT_ID authrtId,A.AUTHRT_NM authrtNm,A.AUTHRT_EXPLN authrtExpln,A.DATA_SCOPE_CD dataScopeCd,A.SORT_SEQ sortSeq, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info U WHERE U.CO_ID=A.CO_ID AND U.AUTHRT_ID=A.AUTHRT_ID AND U.USE_YN='Y') userCount FROM co_authrt_info A WHERE A.CO_ID=#{coId} AND A.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ,A.AUTHRT_ID

SELECT M.MENU_SN menuSn,M.MENU_CD menuCd,M.WORKSPC_ID workspcId,W.WORKSPC_NM workspcNm,M.UP_MENU_SN upMenuSn,M.MENU_NM menuNm, M.MENU_URL_ADDR menuUrlAddr,M.MENU_TYPE_NM menuTypeNm,M.MENU_ICON_NM menuIconNm,M.MENU_LV menuLv,M.MENU_SORT_SEQ menuSortSeq, CASE WHEN R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END authrtGrntYn FROM menu_info M JOIN workspc_info W ON W.WORKSPC_ID=M.WORKSPC_ID AND W.USE_YN='Y' LEFT JOIN co_authrt_menu_rel R ON R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND R.MENU_SN=M.MENU_SN AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' WHERE M.MENU_USE_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_CD NOT LIKE '%_DASHBOARD%' ORDER BY W.SORT_SEQ,M.MENU_SORT_SEQ,M.MENU_SN

SELECT M.MENU_CD FROM co_authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN=R.MENU_SN WHERE R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN='Y' UNION SELECT M.MENU_CD FROM menu_info M WHERE M.MENU_USE_YN='Y' AND M.AUTHRT_CHK_YN='N'

SELECT DISTINCT M.MENU_URL_ADDR FROM co_authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN=R.MENU_SN WHERE R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_URL_ADDR IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT M.WORKSPC_ID FROM co_authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN=R.MENU_SN JOIN workspc_info W ON W.WORKSPC_ID=M.WORKSPC_ID WHERE R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_USE_YN='Y' AND W.USE_YN='Y'
SELECT WORKSPC_ID FROM user_workspc_rel WHERE USER_ID=#{value} AND DFLT_YN='Y' AND USE_YN='Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu_info WHERE MENU_URL_ADDR=#{requestUrl} AND MENU_TYPE_NM=#{menuTypeNm} AND MENU_USE_YN='Y' AND AUTHRT_CHK_YN='Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM co_authrt_menu_rel R JOIN menu_info M ON M.MENU_SN=R.MENU_SN WHERE R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND R.AUTHRT_GRNT_YN='Y' AND M.MENU_URL_ADDR=#{requestUrl} AND M.MENU_TYPE_NM=#{menuTypeNm} AND M.MENU_USE_YN='Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM co_authrt_info WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND USE_YN='Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND USE_YN='Y'
SELECT DATA_SCOPE_CD FROM co_authrt_info WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId} AND USE_YN='Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_info B WHERE B.BIZ_ID=#{bizId} AND B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID=#{userId} AND M.USE_YN='Y')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schdl_info S WHERE S.SCHDL_SN=#{schdlSn} AND S.CO_ID=#{coId} AND S.USE_YN='Y' AND (S.RGTR_ID=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM schdl_user_rel R WHERE R.SCHDL_SN=S.SCHDL_SN AND R.USER_ID=#{userId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE co_authrt_info SET AUTHRT_NM=#{authrtNm},AUTHRT_EXPLN=#{authrtExpln},MDFCN_DT=NOW() WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM co_authrt_menu_rel WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId}
mapper.update: UPDATE co_authrt_info SET USE_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW() WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND AUTHRT_ID=#{authrtId}
UPDATE user_workspc_rel SET DFLT_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW() WHERE USER_ID=#{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_workspc_rel(USER_ID,WORKSPC_ID,DFLT_YN,USE_YN,REG_DT) VALUES(#{userId},#{workspaceId},'Y','Y',NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DFLT_YN='Y',USE_YN='Y',MDFCN_DT=NOW()
